title: DR1 shows the identification task on the hub only once the chosen species need identifiers; the frontend shows "Animal identification details" on every notification, including one with no commodity chosen at all.

finding.frontend: "Animal identification details" is a permanent row in the second section, present even on the hub for a notification where nothing has been imported yet — the fe-hub-no-commodity capture shows it, blocked, above a page with no commodities on it. The row is declared without the conditional flag its neighbours use (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/flow/task-rows.js:41-45), and only a conditional row is dropped when nothing it covers applies (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/hub/controller.js:93 and :116-118). The transit-countries row in the same task list is conditional and is correctly absent from all three captures.
finding.prototype: DR1 adds "Identification details" to the task list only when at least one selected species has identifier fields (app/routes.js:5778-5782, testing the rule at app/routes.js:1489-1493). The captured DR1 hub, with no species chosen, has no identification row: its second section holds Commodity details and Additional details and nothing else.
finding.difference: Drop the identification row from the hub when no commodity line needs identifiers, the way the transit-countries row already drops. Two things have to move together: the row needs the conditional flag, and its status has to resolve to not-applicable in that case — the row's part is a facet of the commodityLines collection and a facet is keyed on its parent collection, so the flag on its own will not hide it while commodityLines is in scope. Without the change a user importing a species with no identifier requirement is shown a task that can never be completed, and a user who has chosen nothing yet is shown a task about animals they have not named.
finding.falsifiedBy: A frontend hub for a notification with no commodity lines that does not list an animal identification row.
finding.verification: Opened the fe-hub, fe-hub-no-commodity and dr1-notification-hub DOMs and screenshots, and read task-rows.js:27-59, hub/controller.js:93-123, bridge/status/index.js:87-99 and routes.js:1489-1493 + 5773-5782. Ran the falsifier against fe-hub-no-commodity: the row "Animal identification details" is present, blocked, in section 2 of a hub whose commodity totals panel is absent because there are no commodity lines, so the row is shown for a notification with nothing to identify. The frontend mechanism holds — the animalIdentification entry at task-rows.js:41-45 carries `parts` but no `conditional: true`, and `isHiddenRow` requires both `row.conditional` and a NA status. On the DR1 side the identification item is spread in behind `hasAnimalIdentifiersRequired(sessionData)`, which is true only if some selected species has identifier fields, and the captured DR1 hub's section 2 holds exactly Commodity details and Additional details. Both cited ranges resolve to what the sentences say. RUBRIC 2 fired on the remedy rather than the claim: the difference slot said marking the row conditional would be enough, but `statusOf` filters parts by `partKey`, and for the facet `{ collection: 'commodityLines', only: ['animalIdentifiers'] }` that key is `commodityLines` — so the row only reaches NA if the parent collection itself leaves scope. Narrowed the difference slot to say both halves are needed. The finding itself stands.
finding.correction: CLAIMED (difference slot): "Mark the identification row conditional so it disappears when no commodity line needs identifiers, the way the transit-countries row already does." TRUE: the conditional flag is necessary but not sufficient. `isHiddenRow` hides a row only when its status is NA, and `statusOf` returns NA only when no part is in scope; the identification row's part is a facet whose `partKey` is the parent `commodityLines` collection, not the `animalIdentifiers` group, whereas the transit-countries row's part is a scalar whose own scope flips. CHECKED against bridge/status/index.js:87-91, bridge/status/classification/index.js:11-12 and task-rows.js:41-45 and :47. The frontend and prototype slots are untouched.
